# Granularity Level

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:GranularityLevel`](gmeow-GranularityLevel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/GranularityLevel>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)

A level of detail / resolution at which a value is expressed — a point on an open, ordered, domain-general axis (spatial: point ≺ address ≺ city ≺ region ≺ country; temporal: day ≺ month ≺ year ≺ decade ≺ century). The explicit facet behind 'no silent precision', and the axis that [`gmeow:coarsenTo`](../properties/gmeow-coarsenTo.md) generalizes along. Levels are individuals (never per-level subclasses), ordered by [`gmeow:coarserThan`](../properties/gmeow-coarserThan.md) and aligned to external resolution vocabularies (OWL-Time [time:TemporalUnit](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#TemporalUnit), ISO 19112 LocationType) by [skos:exactMatch.](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#exactMatch.)

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:GranularityLevel`](gmeow-GranularityLevel.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
